candidates.summary: Drop the restores of &9F, &A0, &B0, &B1, &B6 (the renderer leaves them as it found them: never written, or put back by buffer_to_view) and the dead LDA zp_save + 21: 5 load/store pairs gone. Supersedes the other two (overlapping alternatives). Leaves line 120's LDA zp_save + 17 (outside the window) dead: dropping it too is a further 4 cycles, 3 bytes.
candidates.equivalence: restore_game_zp has one caller (render's closing JMP, render.6502 line 563) and save_game_zp one (line 338, after prebuild and kc_build); between them only render's own code runs (the one game.6502 routine it calls, check_if_mover_is_on_screen, writes no zero page), and the vsync interrupt writes only field_count, game_over_cooldown, shown_screen and its own variables. &9F top_palette_value, &A0 firing_frame, &B6 delta_low/first_mover/target: no write to them anywhere in the renderer family (names and literals grepped over src/, the symbol dump has no other assignment at those addresses), so their restore stores back the byte already there. &B0/&B1 crtc_start_address_high/low: written in the renderer only by buffer_to_view and history_to_view; history_to_view has one caller (apply_entries), always followed by .scrolled's buffer_to_view slot 2, which stores back what view_to_buffer slot 2 took at line 348, and nothing between save_game_zp (338) and that view_to_buffer writes them; nothing after line 515 writes them (put_on, ren_plot_lives and player_done only read). So at restore time &B0/&B1 already hold the saved values and the restore is a no-op. The dead LDA zp_save + 21 only set A, N, Z, which the next LDA sets again (A and flags not live). Exit state: A = zp_save + 33 and the flags of that load, as before; no label inside the window.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings: none moved that matter. The window has no branches or indexed reads; restore_game_zp (&8D95 in the unshifted build) is followed only by render_bss_zero (start-up, run once), so nothing hot slides; the tail code is 25 bytes shorter. Facts relied on: render.6502 lines 338 (save_game_zp), 348 (view_to_buffer slot 2), 501 (history_to_view, only caller), 515 (buffer_to_view slot 2), 563 (JMP restore_game_zp, only caller); renderer never writes top_palette_value/firing_frame/delta_low (grep; zplive 2026-10-22, 6000 frames seed 1, shows the renderer writing none of &9F &A0 &B0 &B1 &B6 even though &A0/&B0/&B1 are logic-live); the interrupt does not write them; zp_save + 17..20 and + 25 stay written by save_game_zp (harmless, outside window).
